verdict.rationale: The README says the skill uses the open Agent Skills format, a folder with a SKILL.md, and works in any agent that supports skills. Installation is just copying the skill folder into a personal or project skills directory, and the bundled tools are dependency-free Python scripts. The zip and plugin options are only packaging conveniences, not a proprietary format. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of the skill actually running in a non-Claude harness.
